name: ShellBrand
description:
The product mark in the top-left corner, centred over the rail: the home link. In Glass UX it
goes to the All organisations dashboard, so it also resets the scope (R5.2).
signature: ({ label, mark, render, className, ...rest }: ShellBrandProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip: "Glass UX home, all organisations".

props.name: mark
props.description: The mark. Default: the product's configured mark (<BrandMark mark="product" />).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
